Hi Sean —

Thanks for the invite. I wanted to flag that our procurement and security teams have put the live demo on hold until we get a few items completed: the vendor questionnaire (attached), a quick SOC 2 summary, and our standard redline review of master services agreement language. Our CTO is travelling late next week so availability is constrained.

Do you have a point person who can own the questionnaire? Also, would Redwood be willing to provide a short recorded walkthrough that we can share with the internal reviewers in the meantime? That would help unblock a decision while legal finishes the contract review.

- SOC 2 summary (scope, last audit date, auditor contact) — Sean attached our 1-pager; I’ll add the auditor contact and detail on encryption/access controls.

That preflight can be next Tue/Wed (2027-12-07 / 2027-12-08) — please propose times. If procurement confirms 2027-12-08 as the completion target, we should align our internal owners for those dates.
